key_values.region: Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo

formulas.rain_mean_mm: mean of two regional accumulated-precipitation means

decision_rule.summary: Use the label only when acute surface concentration and impact gates pass while the rainfall gate does not pass.

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested fields, numeric types, gate booleans, and final answer label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for minor formatting or rounding issues that leave the ledger interpretable.

criteria.name: Surface ratio arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes radar concentration 85.599, optical concentration 26.680, and acute-to-annual ratio 3.307.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for one or two correct ratios or a correct formula with arithmetic errors.

criteria.name: Surface gate
criteria.description: Applies the surface gate correctly using thresholds 80, 20, and 3.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing strong acute concentration but missing one threshold.

criteria.name: Rainfall gate
criteria.description: Computes rain_mean_mm as 5.164 and marks the rain gate false under the 10 mm threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a close rainfall mean with the wrong boolean or a correct boolean with incomplete arithmetic.

criteria.name: Impact ledger
criteria.description: Computes people per destroyed home 43.91 and fatalities per 100,000 people 72.87 from the report and population values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct impact-derived value.

criteria.name: Computed label
criteria.description: Derives the expected label from true surface and impact gates with a false rain gate.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a compatible short label with one gate error.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation within the numeric ledger and avoids unsupported exact impact statements.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for this item if unsupported exact impact statements are introduced.
